Name: Ferngill Broadcasting Company - FBC
Author: Scarlett28
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/44209/44209-1774481750-1110727053.png[/img][/center]

[size=4]This mod adds 4 new TV channels the farmer can buy a seasonal subscription to. The 4 channels will each recommend, in a (hopefully) not immersive breaking way, other mods I've personally enjoyed and would recommend. The list of mods being recommended is randomized as to not favor some mods over others but this also means that you can get repeats. If you do happen to get a repeat or you simply want another recommendation in the same day, simply wait for the in-game time to pass and make sure to exit and enter your house again.

[list]
[*][b]Arcane Innovations TV[/b] - This channel focuses on mods that are related to either magic or mods that add quality of life or new mechanics into the game, the mods in this second category will usually be referred to as "technologies" in-game.
[*][b]Beyond The Valley TV[/b] - Here you will get recommended mods that add new locations to the game, these can be just a single location or full expansions.
[*][b]Bits and Bobbles TV[/b] - This is kind of a telemarketing channel or an ADs channel where mods adding crops, recipes, animals, machines, etc. will be showcased as the products.
[*][b]Meet The Neighbours TV[/b] - Think of this as kind of a "celebrity news and gossip" type of channel but for modded NPCs and community news. Here you'll get recommendations for mods that either add new NPCs or add something to the social aspect of the game.
[/list]
[b][size=5]HOW TO USE:[/size][/b]

At first there will be only one new channel on your TV called "Ferngill Broadcasting Company". If you choose to watch this channel you will be prompted to choose if you want to buy a subscription for 1000 gold or not. If you buy the subscription, you will receive a letter about it the next day and have access to the 4 new channels.
Your subscription will expire when the season changes. You will receive a letter letting you know when it's about to expire, and on the last day of the season, a 5th channel called "Ferngill Broadcasting Company" will appear on the TV, which will allow you to renew your subscription.[/size]
